records.title: Development of medical colleges in Gondia and Bhandara
Introduction of new Superfast train between Gondia and Mumbai
details:
(a) whether Government is considering introducing a new daily Superfast, Vande Bharat, or Express train between Gondia and Mumbai or extending existing rail services, in view of the long-standing demand from Gondia and Eastern Vidarbha; and 
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?

records.title: Development of Gondia Railway Junction
details:
(a) whether Government has taken cognizance of the fact that Gondia Junction is one of the major railway junctions in the country, from where a large number of mail/express and superfast trains pass every day, but many of these trains do not stop at Gondia, causing serious inconvenience to millions of passengers, students, traders and patients; and
(b) if so, the details of such trains and the reasons for not providing stoppage facilities to these trains?
